seasonIndex.plot: Best-selling mystery novelist Rick Castle’s unique approach to crime solving may have won over Detective Kate Beckett, but after crossing her, Castle is going to have to do his best work to get her back on his side.

She’s still armed. He’s still dangerous. And their chemistry is hotter than ever. Season three finds both Richard Castle and Detective Kate Beckett pursuing romantic options of their own. Their signals may be crossed, but this duo hasn’t lost any of their spark. With Beckett’s intrepid police work and Castle’s uncanny insight, solving murder has never been so much fun.

Prepare for a season full of suspense as Castle works to identify Beckett's shooter while Beckett struggles with the aftermath of her near-death encounter. All the while, the duo tackles a new batch of New Your City's most interesting cases.

Now that Castle and Beckett have finally given in to their true feelings for each other, how will it affect their work together? As they try to keep their new relationship under wraps from their co-workers, the unlikely duo must track down the murderer of Beckett's mother, find the perpetrator of a major conspiracy and untangle a line of investigation that links Castle to a ritualistic killing.

After Castle's stunning romantic proposal to Beckett, what happens next? The magnetic crime-fighting couple faces a whole new set of challenges as they juggle wedding plans and their most intriguing cases yet.

Beckett's new job with the Justice Department takes her away from the wisecracking love of her life. But Castle's devotion to his new fiancee - and her fascinating line of work - jeopardizes her career and creates a chain of events that might separate them forever. Back on the home front, Castle is none too pleased to discover his daughter has seemingly been captivated by, and now living with, her new, free-spirited boyfriend.

The wedding bells are ringing, but will Castle and Beckett really tie the knot? On the biggest day of his life, Castle is nowhere to be found, and it's not because he has cold feet. Now, in a season of brilliant twists and turns, Castle and Beckett take on New York City's most fascinating cases while they try to solve the mystery of their own relationship.
In the Season 7 finale, Beckett was faced with a choice about her future.  Now that she's been promoted to Captain, how will New York's famous  couple adapt in Season 8?

episodes.name: Tradimenti
episodes.plot: Un adolescente la cui famiglia benestante è caduta in disgrazia viene ritrovato morto su una barca  a remi al Central Park. Mentre Castle e Beckett cercano di ricostruire gli eventi, i suoi amici fanno tutto il possibile per ostacolare l'indagine. Separando la verità dalle bugie, emerge una storia di tradimento e ossessione. Nel frattempo, Castle si chiede se può lasciare Martha sola a casa mentre accompagna Alexis in gita scolastica a Washington. Martha sarà anche un'aspirante "life coach", ma non per questo è affidabile.

episodes.name: Giochi pericolosi
episodes.plot: Quando il cadavere di un consigliere cittadino di New York City candidato alla rielezione viene trovato morto avvolto in una coperta e il caso viene assegnato a Beckett, lei e Castle entrano nel mondo della politica. Nel frattempo, l'ultimo romanzo di Castle della serie Derrick Storm arriva in libreria, portando sua madre a cercare qualsiasi difetto. episodes.name: La posta in palio
episodes.plot: Inizia una nuova stagione della serie e la detective Beckett non ha più notizie di Castle sin da quando l'uomo è partito per gli Hamptons alcuni mesi prima per terminare il secondo romanzo su Nikki Heat. L'unica cosa che la Beckett, Ryan ed Esposito hanno visto dello scrittore è una sua figura in cartone che pubblicizzava un evento in cui avrebbe autografato i suoi libri. Così, quando la Beckett e la sua squadra, sulle tracce di un assassino, fanno irruzione in un appartamento buio, l'ultima cosa che si aspettano di trovare è Castle, in carne ed ossa e con una pistola in mano, accanto al cadavere di una donna. Mentre Castle dichiara la propria innocenza, Kate non può fare altro che arrestarlo per presunto omicidio.

6.plot:
After Castle's stunning romantic proposal to Beckett, what happens next? The magnetic crime-fighting couple faces a whole new set of challenges as they juggle wedding plans and their most intriguing cases yet.

Beckett's new job with the Justice Department takes her away from the wisecracking love of her life. But Castle's devotion to his new fiancee - and her fascinating line of work - jeopardizes her career and creates a chain of events that might separate them forever. Back on the home front, Castle is none too pleased to discover his daughter has seemingly been captivated by, and now living with, her new, free-spirited boyfriend.
